## Problem and resulting behavior / 问题与修改后的行为

Explain the user-visible change and why it is needed. / 说明用户能够感知的变化及原因。

## Validation / 验证

- Relevant tests and actual results, including skips/limitations / 相关测试与实际结果，包括跳过项与限制：
- Source/citation compatibility, persistence and recovery impact / 对资料、引用兼容性及保存、恢复的影响：
- Docs and all 12 language catalogs updated when applicable / 按需同步文档与全部 12 种语言目录：

## Contribution checklist / 贡献检查

- [ ] My commits have a DCO sign-off (`git commit -s`); my contribution is under MIT. / 提交带有 DCO 签署，贡献采用 MIT。
- [ ] No private documents, credentials, raw prompts/responses, or personal diagnostics are included. / 不含私有资料、凭据、原始提示或响应、个人诊断。
- [ ] Tests use isolated data and test providers; existing user data was not used. / 测试使用隔离数据和测试服务，不使用现有用户数据。
- [ ] Any migration is additive/ordered; original source identities and saved artifacts remain compatible. / 迁移新增且有序，原始资料标识与已保存产物保持兼容。
